title: gfilho.net — Infrastructure & Tunnel
description: Diagnosis of the hosting: systemd services, Cloudflare Tunnel, nginx, probe phases, WSL host resources, publishing, backups and the monitoring pipeline

list.name: WSL starts
list.textFormat: WSL was not running before this point: the site was offline

panels.title: Services now
panels.description: systemd state of the hosting services (RUNNING, STOPPED or FAILED; NO DATA = node-exporter is not answering), units in a failed state, times systemd restarted nginx or cloudflared after a crash (Restart=on-failure) since WSL started, and how long WSL has been running.

panels.title: Service history
panels.description: State of each hosting service over time, one cell per interval. A cell shows the worst state inside it, so a short outage between two samples is not hidden. Blank = no data.

panels.title: Tunnel now
panels.description: Active connections to the Cloudflare edge (cloudflared keeps 4; 0 = the site is unreachable), their average smoothed QUIC round-trip time, connections registered in the selected range (4 at every cloudflared start, then one per reconnect) and requests or streams cloudflared could not deliver to nginx.

panels.title: Connected data centres
panels.description: The Cloudflare data centre each of the 4 tunnel connections is attached to (named after the nearest airport: LIS = Lisbon, AMS = Amsterdam). Visitors reach the site through any of them; if one drops, the others keep it online.

panels.title: Tunnel responses by status code
panels.description: HTTP status codes nginx returned through the tunnel, in requests per hour (areas, stacked), and requests or streams cloudflared could not deliver (red lines, should stay at 0).

panels.title: Edge link
panels.description: Active tunnel connections (left axis, normal 4: dashed line) and the smoothed QUIC round-trip time of each connection (right axis, milliseconds as cloudflared reports it). Reconnections are marked by the "Tunnel registrations" annotation.

panels.title: Request rate · nginx vs tunnel
panels.description: Requests per hour counted by nginx on all its servers (production, staging, the monitoring probes and the exporter's own status requests) and by cloudflared (everything that came in from the internet). The visitor share is on Analytics & Security.

panels.title: nginx connections
panels.description: Open client connections in nginx (stub_status): reading the request, writing the response, idle keep-alive.

panels.title: Response time by phase
panels.description: Where the time of the probe to https://gfilho.net/ goes (stacked; the total is the probe time): DNS, connect, TLS, processing (Cloudflare edge → tunnel → nginx until the first byte) and transfer.

panels.title: CPU & memory
panels.description: Busy CPU (everything but idle) and memory in use (total minus available) of the WSL VM, which the Ascender lab shares.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used and available memory in the WSL VM (stacked: the top is the total).

panels.title: Pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Linux pressure stall information: share of time at least one task had to wait for CPU, memory or I/O. Sustained values mean the VM is short of that resource even when the usage figures look fine.

panels.title: Disk space
panels.description: Used space, computed like df. "/" is the WSL virtual disk: it reports 1 TB but grows inside a file on the Windows drive C:, so C: is the real limit. Dashed line: 90 % (DiskAlmostFull and HostDriveAlmostFull fire at 10 % free).

targets.legendFormat: C: (Windows drive holding the virtual disk)

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Traffic on the physical network interfaces (eth*); localhost, Docker and Kubernetes interfaces are left out.

panels.title: Publishing & backups
panels.description: The production web root (/var/www/html) and the snapshots that deploy.sh and install-nginx.sh keep in /var/backups/gfilho before every change (the rollback points).

panels.title: Monitoring pipeline
panels.description: Is the monitoring itself working? Scrape targets Prometheus cannot reach (their alerts cannot fire), rule evaluations that failed and log lines Alloy dropped in the selected range, and the age of the custom gfilho_* metrics (the timer runs every 2 minutes; CustomMetricsStale fires after 10).

panels.title: Maintenance
panels.description: Package updates waiting in the local APT cache (SecurityUpdatesPending fires after 3 days) and whether a reboot is needed to finish them.

panels.title: Installed versions
panels.description: Hosting components (refreshed every 2 minutes).

panels.title: nginx errors
panels.description: nginx error.log. "open() failed" means a request for a file that does not exist (a 404).

panels.title: Service warnings
panels.description: Warnings and errors from cloudflared, nginx, logrotate and the metrics timer (systemd journal).
